patch_description: The main plateau across all generations is seed diversity: all four seeds produce similar boundary-ringed basins. I add structured asymmetric seeds built directly in the valid domain (no post-hoc rescaling): a two-arc cluster configuration, a rounded-square boundary, an Archimedean spiral, and a 7-outer/6-inner ring (3-fold symmetric style). I also add a second restart pass with perturbation of the best configuration found so far, which gives the hill-climb an escape from local optima, and extend the time limit to 3.0s to match the better-scoring prior runs.
